paper: AlphaAgentEvo: Evolution-Oriented Alpha Mining via Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of AlphaAgentEvo in which a persistent multi-turn policy samples four factor offspring per step, receives an explicit five-component hierarchical reward, updates feature/operator preferences from group-relative advantages, retains a diverse elite pool, and deploys the best training-only alpha; not the missing Qwen3 policy, GRPO trajectories, native tools, factors, or checkpoints.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: A multi-turn agent starts from a seed alpha, generates and evaluates offspring through tools, receives feedback, and refines its strategy over turns rather than performing one-shot search.
The agent reward combines validity, performance quality, diversity, novelty, and tool efficiency with capped components and an explicit direction-aware objective.
Qwen3 policies are trained for 150 steps with group-relative policy optimization and a maximum of four factor-evaluation tool calls per trajectory.
The trained policy increases exploration, stabilizes consistency, improves pass rates, and retains a structurally diverse top-alpha set rather than repeatedly exploiting one motif.
An evolved alpha forms a cross-sectional top-10-percent portfolio with five-day rebalancing; common monthly deciles preserve the top-tail ranking role.

agentic_rl_policy.seed_schedule: sample from the elite pool after the first step; fall back to a policy-weighted grammar candidate
agentic_rl_policy.offspring_neighbor_rule: share at least one feature component with the seed alpha
agentic_rl_policy.selection_rule: retain the highest hierarchical-reward offspring in the elite pool; deploy the final highest-reward alpha with quality and name tie-breaks

hierarchical_reward.validity: one for finite formation-only factor output, else zero
hierarchical_reward.quality: average of capped absolute mean RankIC and RankICIR ranks on training data
hierarchical_reward.diversity: one minus maximum absolute RankIC-history correlation to current elites
hierarchical_reward.novelty: fraction of feature components and operator family absent from the seed alpha
hierarchical_reward.tool_efficiency: one divided by call number with denominator floored at one
hierarchical_reward.direction: orient final alpha by the sign of training mean RankIC

portfolio_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the final training-selected oriented alpha enters fixed value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

approximated_elements: JKP characteristics replace AlphaEvo500/Alpha158 and China equity fields
a finite symbolic grammar replaces free-form Qwen3 alpha expressions
deterministic factor evaluation replaces the unavailable parser/backtest tool
feature and operator logits replace Qwen3 policy parameters

RankIC-history correlation replaces AST structural similarity
one best alpha replaces missing native offspring and checkpoints
common monthly deciles replace five-day top-10-percent execution
invented_elements: the twelve seed features and 210-candidate grammar
the exact capped reward formulas and component weights
the tool-denominator floor resolving the paper ambiguity
the policy learning rate and logit clip
the deterministic seed and tie-breaking rules
